target.name: Wrap selected messages in loop fragment

after.text:
@startuml
actor user
participant app
participant db
user -> app: login
app -> db: query
db --> app: rows
app --> user: ok
@enduml

uml-pg-status.text: Drag a highlighted element. Tab to focus, arrows to nudge, Delete to remove.

uml-pg-tool-status.text: Could not locate the selected messages in the source.

uml-pg-class-selection.text: Select one class to edit its name or members.

after.properties:
- region "2 selected":
  - heading "2 selected" [level=2]
  - button "✕ Delete"
  - paragraph: 2 relations selected. Drag any selected element to move all together. Press Delete to remove all.
  - group "Wrap in combined fragment":
    - text: Wrap in combined fragment loop [
    - textbox "loop fragment condition":
      - /placeholder: while condition
      - text: until rows arrive
    - text: "]"
    - button "Confirm wrap": ✓
    - button "Cancel wrap": ✕
